# Super Wok Restaurant

> Authentic Chinese and Canadian cuisine in Aylmer, Ontario. Dine in, take out, or get free delivery.

Super Wok Restaurant (富食軒) is a family restaurant in Aylmer, ON serving authentic Chinese cuisine alongside Canadian comfort food. Fully licensed under L.L.B.O.

## Contact & Location

- Phone: (519) 765-3184
- Address: 287 Talbot St W #3, Aylmer, ON N5H 1J9, Canada
- Website: https://superwokrestaurant.ca

## Services

- Dine In: Welcoming dining room, perfect for families and gatherings
- Take Out: 10% off pick-up orders over $36 before tax (cash only, not valid with lunch special)
- Delivery: Free delivery on orders over $40 before tax (town-limited area, cash only)
- L.L.B.O. Licensed (alcohol service available)

## Specials & Promotions

### Students & Seniors Lunch Special
Dine in only · 11:00 am – 3:00 pm · No substitutions
Includes: Sweet & Sour Chicken Balls, Sweet & Sour Spare Ribs, Plain Fried Rice, one soft drink or hot tea

### Friday All-You-Can-Eat Buffet
Kids under 3 eat free.
- Lunch: 11:30 am – 1:30 pm
- Dinner: 5:00 pm – 8:00 pm

### Pick-Up Discount
10% off orders over $36 before tax. Cash only. Not valid with lunch special.

### Free Delivery
On orders over $40 before tax. Town-limited area, cash only.

## Menu Categories

Lunch Special, Soup, Appetizers, Sweet & Sour, Rice, Chow Mein & Chop Suey, Egg Foo Young, Honey Garlic, Beef, Chicken, Shrimp, Noodles, Szechuan & Curry, Combination Plates, Canadian Dishes, Desserts, Beverages

Full menu: https://superwokrestaurant.ca/menu

## Popular Dishes

- Chicken Chow Mein — classic stir-fried noodles with vegetables and tender chicken
- Chicken Fried Rice — wok-tossed rice with egg, green onions, and house seasonings
- Sweet & Sour Chicken Balls — golden crispy chicken in signature sweet and sour sauce
- Sweet & Sour Spare Ribs — tender ribs glazed in bold tangy house sauce
- General Tao's Chicken — crispy chicken in bold slightly spicy house sauce
- Honey Garlic Spare Ribs — succulent ribs in sweet honey garlic glaze
- Beef with Broccoli — tender sliced beef stir-fried with fresh broccoli
- Lemon Chicken — crispy chicken with tangy lemon sauce
